name: zzBA2_eye_secondary

tests.name: the preview eye level can be read back before anything is changed
the wardrobe is open with the preview window painted
the eye level AND the colourway this job found were both put back

detail.note: wl.Mascot.Primary and Secondary are SAVED settings, so a job that leaves them changed repaints the mascot for the founder and for every other lane until someone notices.

tests.name: every rung set the eye level it asked for

detail.note: a ladder whose knob refuses its values measures one rung four times, and looks exactly like a term that does not matter. That is how this tree lost an evening to SetGlowScale.

tests.name: SECONDARY visibly changes the eyes at some level, with the body unmoved and no clipping

detail.note: THE WHOLE QUESTION, and it is three requirements at once because they pull against each other. A level that makes SECONDARY visible by letting the eyes clip is not a fix -- the founder's Skeleton Flame correction is explicit that the eyes must stay individually readable rather than becoming one blown-out light.

tests.name: at the SHIPPED level, SECONDARY visibly changes the eyes

detail.note: rung zero, and the founder's actual build. If this is red while E04 is green, item 6's channel is correctly wired and invisible at the level that ships -- which is a real defect with a known fix, not a mystery.
